description: Returns the exact x402 payment requirements for a paid resource (amount, asset, network, payTo) so you can construct the signed payment yourself. Open without a key - the requirements are public because paying is the only thing they enable. 80% of agent visits stop at /mcp and never reach a paid path; this tool puts the paywall where the agents actually are.

resource.description: The paid path, e.g. /x402/obs/tick, /x402/obs/agents, /x402/obs/methodology, /x402/template, /x402/audit, or /x402/item/<id> for a micro item

name: get_payment_requirements
title: Get Payment Requirements
